target_customer: Assistant editors, DITs, post supervisors and post houses in film, TV and commercial production
problem: Footage ingest and prep work (offload, checksums, proxies, slating, syncing, organizing) wastes days of skilled editorial time before cutting can start.
business_model: B2B software licensed to post-production teams (pricing not public; demo and download offered)
product_category: Post-production workflow and media management software

founders.name: Tamish Pulappadi
founders.background_notes: YC page also lists him as a former SCPD Studio Operator at Stanford.

founders.name: Archish Arun
founders.background_notes: YC page calls him a published researcher.

technical_complexity.rationale: Timecode and waveform sync, slate reading, checksummed multi-destination offload and NLE export to Premiere, Avid, Resolve and Final Cut are standard media engineering with some hard parts, per the product site.

defensibility.rationale: Workflow tooling that plugs into existing editing suites can be copied by established dailies and offload vendors, though trust of working assistant editors and integrations give some stickiness.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No incumbent action against the company found as of 2026-11.

market_need_then: Founders say they collected stories of lost footage, un-slated shots and wasted days in production and post; YC and the company frame the demand as editorial inefficiency amid AI automation.

branding.domain_note: Uses cocreate.so, not the .com; the plain name is shared by unrelated companies such as an enterprise collaboration product named CoCreate.

identity.visual_style: Minimal, numbered sections 01 to 09, clean layout
identity.voice_and_tone: Technical and workflow focused, tagline 'Cutting edge tools for assistant editors'

branding.community_and_virality: Trade and startup press features (Inverse, DevX) but no evidence of merch or fan community.

brand_strength.rationale: Clean but generic name with name collisions; coverage is about the product rather than the brand.

outcome_analysis: Active as of 2026-11 with no reported exit, shutdown or layoffs. A trade feature appeared in February 2026. Outcome is too early to judge; the wedge is a niche but painful workflow for assistant editors, and the main risks are a small market and copying by established dailies tools.
notes: Funding unverified: aggregators cite a $500K pre-seed (Sep 2025) and Dealroom lists a $125K seed; a Venture Intelligence item says DeVC India invested with no amount. None confirmed by the company or a primary release, so no round recorded. Competitor search returned only unrelated 'CoCreate' products, so the dated competitor list is empty. Team size is listed as 10 in the directory and 4 elsewhere. Archish Arun and Tamish Pulappadi are the founders on the YC page; Sid Yu is named only as a team member there.
